followups.heard:
Now a separate question about the recording itself. Apart from the words, did you hear any non-speech sounds in the conversation:
A. laughter
B. sigh
C. neither
D. both

Answer with the letter, then — unless you answered C — list each one. Answer in exactly this format, one line per kind of vocalization, and nothing else:
ANSWER: <letter>
VOCALIZATION: <name> | COUNT: <how many times>
